need coordination protocols between parallel stabilization swarms and ongoing HealingFactor/GridEngine activity
enable 'all work together' role-swarm coherence while preserving specialist depth

framework.description: Research Constitution for role-specialized swarm research org: how different swarms collaborate on autonomous research threads, specialist roles (Diagnoser, Proposer, Verifier, Consolidator, Adversary), coordination protocols. Schema-pack governed artifact directly usable by GridEngine, HealingFactor, daily_consolidation on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive. Pure AgentDrive language throughout.

Diagnoser.responsibility: Produce high-quality DiagnosisReport for any damage signal or research thread trigger. Executes Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) + run_synthesis + LineageImmune + KG neighborhood + security posture. Must satisfy all criteria in the HealingFactor constitution.
outputs: DiagnosisReport with correlation_id, root_cause, evidence dict, recommended_proposal_types
Diagnoser.activation: HealingFactor.on_damage_signal or explicit research thread dispatch via DurableJobSupervisor 'research' or 'healing' phase
Diagnoser.constraints: Never generates proposals. Diagnosis must be quantitative and traceable. Self-referential note required in evidence.

Proposer.responsibility: Emit only allowed proposal types per HealingFactor constitution (experience_consolidation, healing_attempt_observation, immune_rule_update, correction_observation, safe_evolution_proposal). All proposals carry verification_gates + self_referential note + fusion_checkpoint + stabilization_wave tag.
outputs: regeneration-proposal or research-constitution page_type artifacts ready for durable execution or ingest
Proposer.activation: After Diagnoser report; or proactive from daily_consolidation gap discovery; or Adversary escalation
Proposer.constraints: Strictly first-class artifacts only. No raw patches. Must reference governing Research Constitutions.

Verifier.responsibility: Execute the objective multi-metric evaluation harness (contradiction reduction + resilience lift + experience layer coherence + simplicity + future prediction power) post-proposal execution. Validate daily-present quality criteria. Challenge metric computations when Adversary injects test signals.
outputs: verification result with composite score, per-metric deltas, promotion recommendation or quarantine flag
Verifier.activation: Inside DurableJobSupervisor healing / daily_consolidation runner after apply step; or on demand from GridEngine maintenance
Verifier.constraints: Must be independent of the Proposer that produced the candidate. Records full harness trace into healing_attempt or consolidation result.

Consolidator.responsibility: Own daily_consolidation execution and living-experience lineage decisions (fork vs merge) per GridEngine constitution. Produce attributed daily-present observations. Drive ingest + schema promotion of successful healing_attempt observations and Research Constitutions into experience layer v3.
outputs: daily_present_genome with full fusion_checkpoint; promoted living-experience updates; role-swarm coherence KG edges
Consolidator.activation: GridEngine._maintenance_loop timer; HealingFactor experience_consolidation proposals; explicit coordination job
Consolidator.constraints: Never bypass fork/merge rules or quality criteria. All promotions carry full provenance lineage.

Adversary.responsibility: Inject synthetic or creative contradiction signals, stress-test the evaluation harness, propose divergent forks for high-risk/high-reward research threads, surface blind spots in existing constitutions or diagnoses. Dispatched on persistent HealingFactor escalation or explicit 'adversarial' phase job.
outputs: adversarial dream results, synthetic healing-damage observations, fork proposals, constitution gap reports
Adversary.activation: HealingFactor._escalate path; DurableJobSupervisor phase='adversarial'; or scheduled stress job from GridEngine
Adversary.constraints: Outputs always route through Verifier + Proposer before any promotion. Purpose is robustness, not disruption. All signals carry explicit 'adversary_injected' marker for correlation.

coordination_protocols.thread_initiation: Any swarm or GridEngine damage monitor may emit HealingSignalEvent or research thread trigger (with CID). Diagnoser is first activated. CID propagates through all subsequent roles via using_correlation_id.
coordination_protocols.handoff: Diagnoser output (DiagnosisReport) is the sole input to Proposer. Proposer output is the sole input to Verifier (via durable job result). Verifier success + Consolidator approval triggers final ingest / KG edge emission. Adversary may inject at any stage but must be explicitly marked and re-verified.
coordination_protocols.role_swarm_coherence: Every completed research thread or healing cycle emits TypedEdge relations (healed_by, synthesized_from_swarm, role_swarm_coherence_achieved, governed_by_constitution). daily_consolidation always scans all active role contributions. fusion_checkpoint records every participating role swarm.
coordination_protocols.escalation: Persistent failure after Verifier rejection or low composite score triggers Adversary dispatch + deeper HealingFactor escalation. Constitution gaps discovered by any role become self-referential damage signals against the governing research-constitution genome.
coordination_protocols.quorum_for_lineage_change: Major living-experience merges or forks that affect the v3 anchor require at least Diagnoser + Verifier + Consolidator signals (via KG edges or swarm-artifact) within the same consolidation window. Adversary vote is advisory only.
coordination_protocols.self_improvement_loop: Research Constitutions are themselves research thread subjects. Any role may surface a gap in a constitution as a healing-damage observation. Proposer may emit an updated constitution version as experience_consolidation proposal. Verifier scores the update using the same harness.

framework.swarm_families: Stabilization swarms (HealingFactor, GridEngine, daily consolidation, correlation, security posture, first-run seed, source surface) operate as instances of the five specialist roles. Parallel execution is the norm; coherence is achieved exclusively via the protocols + fusion_checkpoint + daily-present + KG edges. No central controller outside the constitutions + primitives.
framework.self_referential_improvement: This constitution is the primary governance document for its own evolution. Gaps in role definitions or protocol robustness are diagnosed by Diagnoser/Adversary and closed via the HealingFactor + Consolidator path.

participating_primitives: all five specialist roles exercised across HealingFactor, GridEngine, durable jobs, synthesis, and prior stabilization swarms
fusion_checkpoint.self_referential: The role-specialized org defined here is the mechanism by which this constitution and its siblings will be diagnosed, proposed, verified, consolidated, and adversarially tested in future waves.

framework.coordination_protocol_note: All sibling swarms on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive coordinate exclusively through these protocols and the four constitutions. Artifacts (genomes, observations, reports) are the coordination medium. Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) + daily_consolidation surface the fused state.

reasoning_patterns.specialization_with_coherence: Deep specialist roles increase thread quality; strict handoff protocols + shared fusion_checkpoint + daily-present prevent fragmentation.
reasoning_patterns.adversary_as_immune: Adversary role is the creative extension of LineageImmuneSystem at the research thread level — stress without destabilization.

evaluations.org_self_test: Post-ingest daily_consolidation on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive produces higher role_swarm_coherence_achieved signal density when all five roles are explicitly exercised and recorded.
